sections.title: Everything from this unit, in one place
sections.content: Describing where you live chains what you already know from this unit: places with -hoz/-hez/-höz, közel van a X-hoz, the river and the bridge, negyed, and the full -nál/-nél/-hoz/-hez/-höz/-tól/-től set.

items.english: Every morning I go to the bakery.

items.spanish: A park közel van a lakásunkhoz, és szeretek ott sétálni.
items.english: The park is close to our flat, and I like walking there.

sections.content: This is the same kind of sentence-chaining you already used for friendships in Unit 5 — new vocabulary each time, same skill of linking short sentences into a fuller picture.
